name: Princess Kingdom
release_name: Clean layout, continuous artwork, fixes and lighter loading
changes: Rebuilt the layout: a single continuous background and a normal-flow lower section, so controls can no longer overlap or drift from the artwork.
Fixed a startup JavaScript error that stopped the script before the service worker and drawing board were initialised.
Moved the artwork and music out of index.html (3.8 MB to about 170 KB) and precache them for offline use.
Added a confirmation tap before Joc nou erases progress; the current challenge now survives a reload.
